text:
anna-partnerships: Heads up — marketplace listing team asked for SOC report + recent pen-test artifacts for the hardware + SI bundle. Need to confirm who owns upload, redaction, and presigned links.

sam-security: I can take lead on redaction guidance and checklist. Do we have the exact artifacts they want? SOC2 Type II, pen test report, penetration validation logs, and vuln scan exports, right?

chris-sis: Correct. Also vendor attestation PDF from the HW partner and the network segmentation diagram. The SI will only provide integration logs under NDA.

maria-legal: Important: anything with customer data needs to be redacted before sharing. Also we need an audit trail of who accessed the presigned links. NDA signed by SI/HW?

anna-partnerships: NDA is in place with the HW partner but I need to confirm with the SI. Deadline from marketplace is EOD Wed to ingest evidence into their portal.

sam-security: Ok — proposed split-of-responsibility: Redwood security creates redaction-run artifacts + redaction checklist; HW partner uploads raw reports to a secure S3 path; SI uploads its integration logs to the same bucket under a separate prefix; partnership team requests presigned links with 7d TTL. Is that acceptable?

chris-sis: That works. We'll need a manifest CSV with filenames, sha256 hashes, and owner contact for each artifact so the marketplace can verify.

anna-partnerships: I'll send a short template for the manifest. Also need to confirm whether marketplace accepts redacted SOC or wants original with sealed appendix.

maria-legal: Marketplace typically accepts redacted SOC but require an attestation letter. I'll prepare wording for attestation.

sam-security: Devops — can you create a gated presign process that logs requester email and IP and enforces 7d TTL? Also force-file-lock: no public ACLs. Example presign command we can use for automation: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/marketplace/partner123/soc2.pdf --expires-in 604800```

devops-bot: created-ticket: DEVOPS-4821 for presign workflow + access logging. ETA 1 business day.

devops-bot: quick note — S3 bucket is already versioned and access logs are enabled. I will add a lifecycle rule to quarantine presigned objects for 30 days then move to Glacier.

chris-sis: For pen-test reports, the vendor requires we mask IPs and internal hostnames. Sam, can you confirm redaction script and who runs it?

sam-security: I'll own the redaction run. I'll run the script against the partner uploads (will do in a copy of the object, preserve original under restricted path). I'll publish a short audit csv with redaction actions: file, rules-applied, timestamp, operator.

anna-partnerships: Action items: 1) Anna — confirm SI NDA by EOD today. 2) Sam — redact + produce audit CSV by Tue noon. 3) Devops — presign workflow + manifest template by Tue EOD. 4) Maria — attestation wording by Tue EOD. 5) Chris — confirm the HW attestation PDF availability. If we hit any blockers ping me. :thumbsup:

maria-legal: noted. I'll also add a short clause about non-disclosure of redacted fields.

chris-sis: HW partner confirmed they'll upload raw SOC and pen artifacts to /hardware/partner123/ by tomorrow morning.

anna-partnerships: Great — I'll follow up with marketplace contact after we have presigns. Thanks all.

sam-security: I'll post the redaction checklist here once it's ready so we can run a dry-run.

devops-bot: DEVOPS-4821 updated: presign workflow PR queued, access-logging dashboard link: https://internal.devops/reports/DEVOPS-4821

anna-partnerships: Filing this thread in case we need to reference the plan.
